_comments.price_zar: SUBSTITUTE placeholders only — replace with real gallery prices.
_comments.types: OCR on photo labels was imperfect; many pieces are typed as Persian. Correct types here.
_comments.images: Files live in public/carpets/. Product.image is images/<filename>.jpg from the handoff.
_comments.homepage_hero_id: Product id shown as the large home photograph. Prefer a piece with a real type and size.

tagline: A private collection of Persian carpets
enquiry_note: Visit the gallery to view pieces in person.
price_disclaimer: Indicative price — confirm with the gallery

type_copy.Kashan: Central Persian workshop carpets, often with a medallion on a floral field.
type_copy.Mashad: Large-scale Khorasan carpets, typically with rich red grounds.
type_copy.Najafabad: Isfahan-region workshop pieces with curvilinear floral drawing.
type_copy.Persian: Pieces awaiting a more specific workshop attribution.
type_copy.Sarogh: Sarouk-style medallion carpets from western Iran.
type_copy.Tabriz: Northwest Persian workshop carpets with precise curvilinear design.
type_copy.Torkaman: Turkmen tribal rugs with geometric gül motifs.
